item.title: The BIOS password I couldn't find
item.description: I dumped the SPI flash on a password-locked Lenovo V110 and went looking for the supervisor password. It wasn't where I expected. Here's the method, the dead ends, and what I'd check next.

item.title: Turning optimisation off hid more strings than turning it on
item.description: I compiled one small C program three ways and ran strings on each. The unoptimised build hid the most, and the optimised one split a registry key into something grep can't find.

item.title: Running a privilege escalation check on my own laptop
item.description: The first thing you check after getting a shell on a Linux comp is SUID binaries, capabilities and group membership. I ran the same checks on my own machine. The SUID list was fine. My groups weren't.

item.title: Entropy alone flags a quarter of popular domains
item.description: I tested my PCAP analyser's "random-looking domain" check against 33,000 real domains and a few kinds of generated ones. Entropy alone is bad at this, and some malware domains get past the improved check too.
